releaseNotes:
CantosTV 1.6.3

- Trending on Home is now what is actually trending this week that your catalogue has - the same all day, a new list each morning (it used to reshuffle at random every time Home loaded).
- More like this on a movie page now shows films like it: TMDB recommendations for that exact film that are in the catalogue.
- Select multiple: a new round tick everywhere you pick several things.
- Live TV > Continue Watching: Select multiple to remove.
